newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GOI to accept Futuris bid for Elders.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GOI to accept Futuris bid for Elders.

text.p: Elders Australia Ltd said on Wednesday Sir James Goldsmith's General Oriental Investments Ltd had accepted the offer by Futuris Corp Ltd for its stake in Elders.
General Oriental owns about seven percent of Elders. London-based Marathon Funds Management owns about eight of the Australian pastrol group.
Futuris, a diversified industrial group, had about 85 percent of Elders before General Oriental acceptence.
Futuris is offering 10 of its shares for every nine Elders shares plus 23 cents per Elders share.
At 3.05 p.m. (0405 GMT), Elders shares were steady at A$2.11, while Futuris shares were one cent up at A$1.82.
